SuccessEnvelope.description: Universal Response Envelope — all API responses use this structure.

Results.description: Always an array. Length 1 for single items, 0+ for lists.

Additional.description: May contain DelegatedError for downstream failures.

EnvelopeStatus.description: Describes the outcome of the request.

EnvelopeAttributes.description: Describes the shape and size of the result set, plus endpoint tracking.

RequestedEndpoint.description: The Go API endpoint that received the request.

DelegatedEndpoint.description: The downstream endpoint (e.g., PHP/WordPress) the request was proxied to.

TraversalSteps.description: Ordered list of methods/functions invoked during request processing.

EnvelopeNavigation.description: Pagination links for list responses. Omitted for single items.

Pages.description: 5-page sliding window centered on current page.

EnvelopeErrorDetail.description: Error information. Stack traces are config-controlled via ResponseDebug.

StackTrace.description: Full stack trace string (debug mode only).

DelegatedError.description: Error from a delegated downstream call (e.g., Go → PHP). Included in Additional when a proxied call fails.

Message.example: PHP fatal error: Class PDO not found

StackTraceFrames.description: Structured PHP stack frames (debug mode only).
